name: humanizer
description: Write and rewrite human-facing text (web copy, emails, blogs, posts) so it reads like the writer without changing what it says. Two passes: words and phrasing (blader/humanizer, no-ai-slop, humanizer-stack copy tells), then structure (humanizer-stack, StoryScope).

interface.shortDescription: Write and rewrite human-facing text so it reads like the writer: a words pass and a structure pass (blader/humanizer + no-ai-slop + humanizer-stack)
interface.longDescription: Write and rewrite human-facing text (web copy, emails, blogs, posts) so it reads like the writer without changing what it says. Two passes: words and phrasing (blader/humanizer, no-ai-slop, humanizer-stack copy tells), then structure (humanizer-stack, StoryScope).
defaultPrompt: Rewrite this text in my voice without changing its facts.
